mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS meal_id, m.meal_type, m.meal_date, mi.food_code, mi.quantity, f.name AS food_name, f.manufacturer, f.calories, f.carbohydrate, f.protein, f.fat FROM meals m LEFT JOIN meal_items mi ON mi.meal_id = m.id LEFT JOIN foods f ON f.code = mi.food_code WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.meal_date = #{date} ORDER BY CASE m.meal_type WHEN 'BREAKFAST' THEN 1 WHEN 'LUNCH' THEN 2 WHEN 'DINNER' THEN 3 WHEN 'SNACK' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, f.name
INSERT INTO meals (user_id, meal_type, meal_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{mealType}, #{mealDate}) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal_items (meal_id, food_code, quantity) VALUES (#{mealId}, #{item.foodCode}, #{item.quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT code AS food_code, name AS food_name, manufacturer, serving_size, serving_unit, calories, carbohydrate, protein, fat FROM foods WHERE name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN name = #{query} THEN 0 WHEN name ILIKE CONCAT(#{query}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, name LIMIT #{limit}
